purpose: Machine-readable authority boundaries for structured history, rubric learning, and board review activation.

authority.established_story: LUCIA locked chapters and chapter-adjacent established-story profiles
authority.structured_history: LUCIA product-local people-history crates and fixtures
authority.rubric_version_custody: LUCIA scoring rubric and append-only innovation log
authority.board_selection: chapter review artifacts with selected board role files and rationale

pitfall_boundaries.boundary: Structured people-history records compare against established chapters; they do not replace chapter authority.
blocked_claims: valid people-history JSON is the established historical account
compare output replaces source-cited chapter prose
BANISH gamepack scores make a generic history primitive
product-local Rust crates are shared portfolio contracts
pitfall_boundaries.required_owner: LUCIA locked chapters and established-story profiles

pitfall_boundaries.boundary: Rubric learning is append-only and forward-only unless an explicit migration is recorded.
blocked_claims: new rubric version silently rescores locked chapters
typology cluster rewrites historical score meaning
innovation adoption changes past chapter status
research summary may compare old chapters as if scored under the latest rubric

pitfall_boundaries.boundary: The board roster is a specialist catalog; each chapter activates only selected specialists with rationale.
blocked_claims: all board roles are active for every chapter
stale or duplicate roles remain authoritative without selection
board review can omit selected role files and rationale
